name: Dashta eel
description: The Dashta eels were a species of eels native to Ord Cestus and unknown to the outside galaxy. Immature ones were the size of a clenched Human fist when coiled, and had blind eyes. The young had no sexes; after they matured, they entered into sexual differentiation, gained a form of sentience, and grew larger. Unfertilized eggs develop into Dashta eels that remained immature and non-sentient. The head eels were the Guides.
